page.overview:
Who is Earot?

is a reiloran watchman living in Kreviris. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Earot is a hunched and lanky-looking reilora.

Earot is a somewhat restless person who acts as it benefits him, having no defined loyalties. He is quite physical for a reilora, interacting directly with nearby people and objects rather than using his psychic powers.

At some point in his life Earot started working as a watchman in the Overspoke, the highest tower point in The Banners of Kreviris. According to Zhesh he had contact with both the Imperium and the Volition, but was loyal to none, always taking the side of whoever had the advantage in any conflict.
